data.description:
## Context / Problem

The production deploy pins its model classes in `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:97-99` (`REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL`, `REBAR_LLM_STANDARD_MODEL`, `REBAR_LLM_TRIVIAL_MODEL`, currently Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6 and the dated Haiku 4.5 profile), and the Bedrock CloudWatch alarms in `infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf:80-135` key on the same ids as `ModelId` dimensions. The compose file's own comment (lines 93-96) requires the exact inference-profile ids and an alarm update whenever an id changes. When the project moves to Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 (sibling task `beaten-natural-grouse`), both must follow, or the server keeps calling the 4.x models and the alarms watch series that no longer receive data; with `treat_missing_data = "notBreaching"` (`monitoring_eb6e.tf:42`) a stale dimension never pages.

## Approach

Replace the three compose values and the six alarm dimensions with `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` and `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5`, verbatim from `aws bedrock list-inference-profiles --profile frontier --region us-east-1` (measured 2026-11-09: the 5.5 profiles carry no dated suffix). The commit is stacked on the upgrade task's commit (Gerrit parent), so it cannot land first. Because a dimension string that differs from what Bedrock emits fails silently, the change is checked against the metric series Bedrock actually publishes: after the 5.5 provider-parity run makes real calls, `aws cloudwatch list-metrics --namespace AWS/Bedrock --metric-name Invocations --profile frontier --region us-east-1` (read-only) must list each new `ModelId` exactly as the alarms spell it. Applying the terraform and redeploying are operator steps outside this ticket (production is read-only here).

## Scope

- infra/compose/docker-compose.yml (three model env values)
- infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf (six `ModelId` dimensions)
- tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py (pinned ids)

## Testing

- `tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py` updated to the 5.5 ids and passing.
- Live check: the `list-metrics` comparison above, recorded on the ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `git grep -nE 'claude-(opus-4-8|sonnet-4-6|haiku-4-5)' -- infra/compose/docker-compose.yml infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf` prints nothing.
- [ ] `aws cloudwatch list-metrics` output showing each new `ModelId` series, matching the alarm dimensions character for character, is recorded in a ticket comment.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Point deploy model defaults and Bedrock alarms at the 5.5 inference profiles
